opportunities.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
opportunities.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

  • The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement.

  • Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function.

  • A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench.

  • Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body.

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management.

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team.

About TestGorilla

At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.

Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.

After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

About the role

As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â 

Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â  Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.

We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.

Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

  • Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters

  • Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.

  • Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.

  • Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor.

  • Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.

  • Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â 

  • Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.

  • Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities.

  • Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems.

  • Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation.

  • Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before.

  • Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters.

  • Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills.

Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement - let's buck that trend!

Bonus skills

While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following:

  • Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever.

  • Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster.

  • HRIS implementation or migration project experience.

  • Experience supporting a team through organizational change.

What's in it for you?

Please note: In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor.

  • Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world.

  • Competitive compensation: â¬56,520 - â¬70,650 base pay + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component.

  • Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
    *Check out the countries we currently hire from here.

  • Remote work budget: â¬1,000 available each year, or up to â¬2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!

  • Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities.

  • Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches.

  • Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being.

Interested?

At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match.

When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment â it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.

Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20.

Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment? We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the peopleÂ whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video teamÂ constructive feedbackÂ on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world.Â You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Job Snapshot

Location: Remote - California (San Diego or Southern California Preferred)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $28-30 per hour

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Environment: Remote

Reports To: Human Resources Manager

About Pacific Health Group

At Pacific Health Group, we care deeply about the people and communities we serve. We meet individuals with kindness, respect, and understandingâlistening first, honoring each person's journey, and offering support without judgment.

Through compassionate, person-centered healthcare, behavioral health services, and social supports, we walk alongside people as they work toward healing, stability, and a healthier, more hopeful life.

Our Core Values

  • Speak with integrityâclear, respectful, and honest in every interaction
  • Embrace innovation, trying new ideas, learning fast, and improving care.
  • Own our roles, staying accountable for outcomes and documenting accurately
  • Build genuine connections with members, families, and teammates through empathy and cultural sensitivity
  • Lead with trust by being consistent, transparent, and following through
  • Celebrate wins together, recognizing individual and team achievements
  • Collaborate with purpose, partnering across departments and with community providers to solve problems
  • Ask for support and offer support, because thriving together is how we serve our members best

Role Overview & Impact

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Coordination

  • Support candidate communications using approved templates
  • Track candidate status and documentation in the applicant tracking system
  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)
  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

  • Submission of an internal application
  • Recruiter pre-screen
  • Skills assessment if applicable
  • Final interview with hiring leadership
  • Formal verbal offer from authorized hiring representatives

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

AI & Human Interaction in Recruitment

Pacific Health Group uses AI tools to assist with resume matching based on qualifications, skills, and location. All qualified applications are reviewed by our recruiting and HR team to ensure fair, equitable, and human-centered hiring decisions.
